prompts.prompt: What would reach the MD's desk this week if we did nothing?
prompts.answer:
The new HDFC Bank app: 680 negative reviews in the window, versions 11.x averaging 2.38★ against 4.39★ on the previous app. Owner: Digital.
Themes rising with escalation language:
• Card variant migration and forced upgrade: 256 items, up 106% in the second half of the window vs the first (trend within window); 9 mention the RBI, the ombudsman, a court or a complaint number. Highest rung heard: Voice. Owner: Cards.
• Customer care unreachable or unhelpful: 175 items, up 138% in the second half of the window vs the first (trend within window); 19 mention the RBI, the ombudsman, a court or a complaint number. Highest rung heard: RBI Ombudsman. Owner: CX.
Each is routed to its owner with evidence; the MD's office sees only what stays unresolved.

prompts.prompt: Which complaints are most likely to go to the Internal Ombudsman?
prompts.answer:
Climb risk is highest where customers already use escalation language and repeat themselves:
• Recovery and collection conduct: 44.2% of 43 items carry escalation language; 5 say they have raised it before.
• Complaints closed without resolution: 26.4% of 246 items carry escalation language; 39 say they have raised it before.
• Unauthorised transactions: 27.8% of 18 items carry escalation language; 1 say they have raised it before.
Public voice shows the language, not the case outcome; IO referrals are joined in discovery.

prompts.prompt: Is the card variant migration and forced upgrade spike seasonal or new?
prompts.answer: Card variant migration and forced upgrade: 256 items in the window, up 106% in the second half of the window vs the first (trend within window). First heard in this window on 2026-08-04. This source mix has no earlier history, so LisN shows the trend within the window and makes no baseline claim. Seasonal check: in discovery, using your history.

prompts.prompt: Where did we break a TAT promise yesterday?
prompts.answer: On 24 September, 13 public items described a broken timeline: other requests 8, failed-transaction reversal 2, refunds 2, loan disbursal 1. Across the window, the most frequent promise breaks are other requests (281), closure (24), KYC and profile updates (22). Stated TATs are checked against the bank's own commitments in discovery.

prompts.prompt: Where did a proactive cure not land?
prompts.answer: 144 items follow a decline, failed payment or block that a proactive message, auto-reversal or unblock could have handled, and the customer still had to chase it. Leading areas: Account debit freezes and blocks (66), Failed transaction reversal (15), UPI payments failing or pending (13).

prompts.prompt: What should Product hear this week?
prompts.answer:
Product and Digital should hear:

• App features and usability: 288 items
